fixes_vs_round1_tells.trigger broader at the top / thick tip (: c1 rows mapped into our opening (c1 draws the receiver bottom ~2.3 mm higher; x 0.914 in Z): shoulder reaches X 306-308 just below the flange with a crisp knee, blunt ~2 mm round tip; side trigger IoU 0.895 -> 0.946
fixes_vs_round1_tells.chrome streak on the trigger (render tel: root cause: the bevel-modifier rounds were clamped to ~0.06 mm, leaving a flat 6 mm finger face seen at grazing incidence; the blade is now a profiled extrusion with a 0.8 mm concave finger face (0.15 mm edge breaks, round the tip) and a 0.45 mm rear roll. A convex half round was tried first (i5): it only moved the streak to its silhouette
fixes_vs_round1_tells.thick flat strap with bevelled lip, boxi: two rounded beads either side of a V groove on the side face, 8-segment corners (6 showed facets), inner radii rear 6 / front 8 per c1, front outer R 11, bar 0.3 mm deeper
fixes_vs_round1_tells.separate block at the top of the catch: front tab full width only down to Z -33.2 (thin plate per c1), recessed below
fixes_vs_round1_tells.not this part (left to their builders): grip panel / grip top shoulder, selector boss and plate, rivet layout, receiver bottom lip, magazine-catch paddle shape (mag_catch is receiver_right's)

remaining_differences_seen: c1 draws the guard opening ~18 % taller in proportion than the side trace (receiver bottom higher); position stays with the side trace
the catch housing reads narrower in X than c1 (housing/guard width 0.23 vs 0.28); it is bounded by the front leg and the magazine (X 355.1-367.6), so it cannot grow
ROUGH LOOK steel is near-black on the trigger and loop where the sheet shows mid-grey worn steel (shader, not geometry)
a faint light band remains along the lower finger face and the tip end in c1
method: c1 / c6 rectified onto the part's XZ plane at the solved part cameras (trigger_guard_r2.py rectify), read at 1 mm rows (review/detail/trigger_guard/r2b_trace.json); private snapshot of the integrated build (scratch/detail/trigger_guard/base.blend = scratch/AR01_review.blend, base_tris.npz = scratch/form_tris.npz); ROUGH LOOK renders via gunlib DetailKit at the part cameras; harness trigger_guard_dev.py + scratch iter.sh
